name: Web & Game Dev 101
description:
Hi, Trainer! 🔴⚪️ The UP Center for Student Innovations, co-presented by DevelUP Diliman, proudly introduces Web & Game Dev 101! ⚡️
Join us for an exciting two-day event packed with workshops and hands-on activities in both Website Development and Game Development. 💥Whether you're just starting your journey or looking to level up your skills, this is the perfect opportunity to catch ‘em all in the world of coding and creativity!
